evaluations.evidence: search and discover music using content identification or fingerprinting
evaluations.rationale: Can be implemented as a standalone search capability; no other backlog story is a prerequisite at the requirement level.

evaluations.evidence: search and discover music based on my profile
evaluations.rationale: Requires the existence of a user profile (data and/or profile creation/management) which is not provided by any other story; thus it inherently depends on missing prerequisite functionality.

evaluations.evidence: based on other users similar to myself
evaluations.rationale: Inherently depends on having user profiles/behavior data to compute similarity; no prerequisite story in the backlog establishes those profiles/data.

evaluations.evidence: similar to a given music video based on content similarity
evaluations.rationale: Can be delivered as a standalone similarity search given an input video; does not require another story to exist first.

evaluations.evidence: exploiting enriched metadata and image tags
evaluations.rationale: Uses metadata/tags but does not inherently require another specific story in the backlog to be implemented first.

evaluations.evidence: upload tagged videos and have tags available for all further processing steps
evaluations.rationale: Defines its own upload+tagging capability; while other processing may use tags, this story itself does not depend on other stories.

evaluations.evidence: view thumbnail sequences of video segments
evaluations.rationale: Requires videos to be segmented into segments; segmentation capability is provided elsewhere in the backlog.

evaluations.evidence: get info about similar video items and segments
evaluations.rationale: The 'segments' part inherently depends on having segmentation available first.

evaluations.evidence: get info about perceptually similar video items and segments
evaluations.rationale: The 'segments' aspect inherently depends on segmentation being available.

evaluations.evidence: recommendations from similar profiles
evaluations.rationale: Inherently depends on having user profiles and a way to determine similarity between them; no prerequisite story provides profile creation/management.

evaluations.evidence: based on most relevant news events in my area
evaluations.rationale: Inherently depends on determining the user's area/location; no other story provides user location/area setup (map access in ZO-017 is a different feature).

evaluations.evidence: identify persons in videos, and receive related information about them
evaluations.rationale: Can be implemented as a standalone person-identification-and-info feature without requiring another specific backlog story first.

evaluations.evidence: identify products in videos, and receive related information about them
evaluations.rationale: Standalone product identification and info retrieval; no explicit dependency on another story.

evaluations.evidence: identify broadcaster logos in videos, and receive related information about them
evaluations.rationale: Standalone logo identification and info retrieval; no explicit dependency on another story.

evaluations.evidence: identify brands in videos, and receive related information about them
evaluations.rationale: Standalone brand identification and info retrieval; no explicit dependency on another story.

evaluations.evidence: take a picture or upload an image, so that I am recommended with videos related to that picture or image
evaluations.rationale: Defines its own input (picture/image) and output (recommendations); no other story is a prerequisite at the requirement level.

evaluations.evidence: access content using a geographical map and be informed if there are videos covering the area
evaluations.rationale: Can be implemented as a standalone map-based browsing/notification feature; no explicit dependency on another story.

evaluations.evidence: search content items using automatic speech recognition
evaluations.rationale: Standalone ASR-based search; no explicit dependency on another story.

evaluations.evidence: see, validate and edit segmentation of videos
evaluations.rationale: Defines an admin capability around segmentation; does not inherently require another story to be implemented first (segmentation could be produced by existing ingestion or external processes).

evaluations.evidence: annotate news video segments and extract a topic for each segment
evaluations.rationale: Inherently depends on the existence of 'video segments' to annotate.

evaluations.evidence: filter and rank videos based on A/V quality aspects
evaluations.rationale: Standalone filtering/ranking feature over videos; no explicit dependency on another story.

evaluations.evidence: assessment of whether audio material has been edited before the upload
evaluations.rationale: Standalone analysis capability; does not inherently depend on another story in the backlog.

evaluations.evidence: prefilter nudity content
evaluations.rationale: Standalone prefiltering capability; no explicit dependency on another story.

evaluations.evidence: prefilter content using search based on low­level asset information
evaluations.rationale: Standalone prefilter/search capability; no explicit dependency on another story.

evaluations.evidence: validated the ingested contents for copyright infringement
evaluations.rationale: Standalone validation capability; does not inherently require another story in the backlog.

evaluations.evidence: search on high­level asset information such as metadata and tags either recognized by the system of provided by the user
evaluations.rationale: Can be implemented as a standalone search/prefilter feature; does not inherently depend on a specific other story (even if tags may come from multiple sources).

evaluations.evidence: based on automated analysis, citizen annotations, and comments on Talk
evaluations.rationale: Inherently depends on the existence of citizen annotations and Talk comments data, which are not established by any other story in this backlog.

evaluations.evidence: based on annotations and information from Talk comments
evaluations.rationale: Inherently depends on annotations and Talk comments being available; no prerequisite story in the backlog provides those capabilities/data.

evaluations.evidence: identify volunteer types
evaluations.rationale: Requires volunteer/user data and behavior history to classify types; no other story provides volunteer profiling/typing inputs as a prerequisite capability.

evaluations.evidence: preclassify the Galaxy Zoo images using simple low­level image features
evaluations.rationale: Standalone preclassification capability for a dataset; no explicit dependency on another story.

evaluations.evidence: detect Snapshot Serengeti images with no classifiable animals in them
evaluations.rationale: Standalone detection capability; no explicit dependency on another story.

evaluations.evidence: automatic image series detection ... timestamping malfunction
evaluations.rationale: Standalone detection/repair analysis capability; no explicit dependency on another story.

evaluations.evidence: automatic animal species preclassification in Snapshot Serengeti
evaluations.rationale: Standalone preclassification capability; no explicit dependency on another story.

evaluations.evidence: automatic animal attribute preclassification in Snapshot Serengeti
evaluations.rationale: Standalone preclassification capability; no explicit dependency on another story.

evaluations.evidence: automatic animal number detection in Snapshot Serengeti
evaluations.rationale: Standalone detection capability; no explicit dependency on another story.

evaluations.evidence: automatic segmentation or localization of plankton in Plankton Portal
evaluations.rationale: Standalone segmentation/localization capability; no explicit dependency on another story.

evaluations.evidence: detect Plankton Portal images with no classifiable plankton in them
evaluations.rationale: Standalone detection capability; no explicit dependency on another story.

evaluations.evidence: detection of plankton size or orientation
evaluations.rationale: Standalone detection capability; no explicit dependency on another story.

evaluations.evidence: preclassification of plankton species
evaluations.rationale: Standalone preclassification capability; no explicit dependency on another story.

evaluations.evidence: worm motion analysis to reduce video duration
evaluations.rationale: Standalone analysis capability; no explicit dependency on another story.

evaluations.evidence: detect the time ... where the worm lays an egg
evaluations.rationale: Standalone detection capability; no explicit dependency on another story.

evaluations.evidence: detect important features ... in the satellite images
evaluations.rationale: Standalone detection capability; no explicit dependency on another story.

evaluations.evidence: probability/weight of a volunteer’s classification based on their experience
evaluations.rationale: Inherently depends on having recorded volunteer experience/history and classifications; no prerequisite story in the backlog establishes those data/capabilities.

evaluations.evidence: prefiltering of the images to remove artefacts
evaluations.rationale: Standalone prefiltering/cleanup capability; no explicit dependency on another story.

evaluations.evidence: detect moving and transient objects in the images
evaluations.rationale: Standalone detection capability; no explicit dependency on another story.

evaluations.evidence: remove background noise and distracting sounds from the audio files
evaluations.rationale: Standalone audio processing capability; no explicit dependency on another story.

evaluations.evidence: group whale calls that are similar
evaluations.rationale: Standalone clustering/grouping capability; no explicit dependency on another story.

evaluations.evidence: identify the number of whales heard in a single audio file
evaluations.rationale: Standalone counting/estimation capability; no explicit dependency on another story.

evaluations.evidence: know when I should interrupt a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: Inherently depends on having volunteer interaction context and signals (e.g., activity/behavior/annotations) to decide when to interrupt; no prerequisite story provides those inputs.

evaluations.evidence: interrupt a volunteer with text, an image, or a video
evaluations.rationale: Inherently depends on the capability/decision of when to interrupt a volunteer; this story presupposes that interruption triggering exists.

evaluations.evidence: know when I should educate a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: Inherently depends on volunteer interaction context and signals to decide when education is needed; no prerequisite story provides those inputs.

evaluations.evidence: educate a volunteer with text, an image, or a video
evaluations.rationale: Inherently depends on the capability/decision of when to educate a volunteer; this story presupposes that education triggering exists.

evaluations.evidence: which piece of education I should give to a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: Inherently depends on having an education delivery context (that education is to be given) and likely a catalog of education pieces; the backlog provides the triggering/delivery context via other stories.

evaluations.evidence: when a volunteer has made an interesting comment on a subject
evaluations.rationale: Inherently depends on the existence of volunteer comments on subjects (e.g., Talk/comments capability), which is not established by any other story in the backlog.

evaluations.evidence: when Zoonibot should comment on a subject
evaluations.rationale: Inherently depends on the existence of a commenting context and likely detection of interesting comments; it presupposes the condition identified in another story.

evaluations.evidence: when Zoonibot should give an explanation
evaluations.rationale: Inherently depends on having a context/trigger for Zoonibot interventions (similar to deciding when it should comment).

evaluations.evidence: what Zoonibot should say to a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: Inherently depends on Zoonibot having a reason/context to speak (e.g., comment/explanation/education/interrupt flows) defined in other stories.

evaluations.evidence: group subjects by similarity
evaluations.rationale: Standalone grouping capability over subjects; no explicit dependency on another story.

evaluations.evidence: recommend different projects to volunteers based on their previous experiences
evaluations.rationale: Inherently depends on having recorded volunteer previous experiences/history; no prerequisite story provides that data/capability.

evaluations.evidence: see a summary of articles, so that I reuse them
evaluations.rationale: Standalone summarization/view feature; no explicit dependency on another story in the backlog.
